extracted.intended_audience: publishers, journal editors and editorial staff, platform developers, and others implementing or describing peer review models
extracted.subtask_description: Standardized terminology and categories for describing peer review processes and what review-related information is published for journal articles. Intended to help publishers/editors describe review models (identity transparency, interactions, published review information, and post-publication commenting).

rubrics_metrics.name: identity transparency
rubrics_metrics.description: This category describes the extent to which identities of participants are made visible to each other during the review process. Identities not made visible during the process may be made visible at publication on the article page (see section 3, review information published).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this category to state which identities are visible during review; multiple levels are defined (see types).

rubrics_metrics.name: identity transparency: all identities visible
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewer identity is visible to author, author identity is visible to reviewer, reviewer and author identity is visible to (decision-making) editor.

rubrics_metrics.name: identity transparency: single anonymized
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewer identity is not made visible to author, author identity is visible to reviewer, reviewer and author identity is visible to (decision-making) editor.

rubrics_metrics.name: identity transparency: double anonymized
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewer identity is not made visible to author, author identity is not made visible to reviewer, reviewer and author identity is visible to (decision-making) editor.

rubrics_metrics.name: identity transparency: triple anonymized
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewer identity is not made visible to author, author identity is not made visible to reviewer, reviewer & author identity is not made visible to (decision-making) editor.

rubrics_metrics.name: reviewer interacts with
rubrics_metrics.description: This category relates to direct interaction or exchange of information (e.g., via submission systems or email) during the peer review process. Multiple types of this category may be selected where applicable. Whatever is communicated about the review process after publication is included in section 3, review information published.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select and list any applicable interaction types; interactions may be anonymized or visible.

rubrics_metrics.name: reviewer interacts with: editor
rubrics_metrics.description: Communication between editor and reviewer (traditional model). Also known as ‘independent review’. Identities can be anonymized or visible.

rubrics_metrics.name: reviewer interacts with: other reviewers
rubrics_metrics.description: Direct interaction/collaboration (e.g., via submission system or email) between reviewers, or the possibility to receive and/or comment on each other’s reports before reviewer makes recommendation to the editor. Identities can be anonymized or visible.

rubrics_metrics.name: reviewer interacts with: authors
rubrics_metrics.description: Direct interaction/collaboration (e.g., via submission system or email) between author and reviewer before reviewer makes recommendation to the editor. Identities can be anonymized or visible.

rubrics_metrics.name: review information published
rubrics_metrics.description: This relates to information that is published about the review process on the article page. Select and list the items that are applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Items published about the review process (see types) should be listed on the article page; items communicated about the process after publication belong here rather than in the interactions category.

rubrics_metrics.name: review information published: none
rubrics_metrics.description: No information about the review process or editorial decision process is published.

rubrics_metrics.name: review information published: review summaries
rubrics_metrics.description: Can be summaries or parts of the reviews, or a summary of the review process.

rubrics_metrics.name: review information published: review reports
rubrics_metrics.description: Full content of the reviewer reports is published.

rubrics_metrics.name: review information published: review reports (author opt in)
rubrics_metrics.description: Full content of the reviewer reports is published if the corresponding author opts for this.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate when publication of reports depends on author choice.

rubrics_metrics.name: review information published: review reports (reviewer opt in)
rubrics_metrics.description: Full content of the reviewer reports is published if the reviewer(s) opt(s) for this.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate when publication of reports depends on reviewer consent.

rubrics_metrics.name: review information published: submitted manuscript
rubrics_metrics.description: The version of the manuscript that the author submitted for peer review is published.

rubrics_metrics.name: review information published: submitted manuscript (author opt in)
rubrics_metrics.description: The version of the manuscript that the author submitted for peer review is published if the corresponding author opts for this.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate when publication of the submitted manuscript depends on author choice.

rubrics_metrics.name: review information published: author/editor communication
rubrics_metrics.description: Including editor decision letter and reviewer responses (rebuttals).

rubrics_metrics.name: review information published: reviewer identities
rubrics_metrics.description: Identities of the reviewers are published.

rubrics_metrics.name: review information published: reviewer identities (reviewer opt in)
rubrics_metrics.description: The identities of the reviewers are published if the reviewers opt for this.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate when publication of reviewer identities depends on reviewer consent.

rubrics_metrics.name: review information published: editor identities
rubrics_metrics.description: Identities of the handling editors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State whether handling editor identities are published on the article page.

rubrics_metrics.name: post publication commenting
rubrics_metrics.description: Relates to comments on the online published version of the version of record on the publishing platform, and does not include possible integrations with third party platforms (e.g., PubPeer). Article types such as comment / reply / letter are not considered post publication commenting as they are stand-alone publications. Only use this category when applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this category only for on-platform commenting tied to the version of record; distinguish from third-party commentary and formal published commentaries.

rubrics_metrics.name: post publication commenting: open
rubrics_metrics.description: Commenting open to anybody. Can be anonymous, require signing in and/or registration (e.g., via ORCID).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State any authentication or anonymity options for open commenting.

rubrics_metrics.name: post publication commenting: on invitation
rubrics_metrics.description: Only editor- (or publisher-) selected and/or invited individuals can comment on the article post publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: use of terminology / implementation guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Examples and guidance for how the terminology should be used when describing review processes to authors or on article pages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: a Guide for Authors description: identity transparency: single anonymized; reviewer interacts with: editor; review information published: none. If journals allow authors to choose between review models, all options should be listed (e.g., identity transparency: single anonymized, double anonymized). Publishers can include links in descriptions to pages where the terms are explained. It should be actively communicated when post publication commenting is adopted. More information: 10.3789/ansi.niso.z39.106-2023.
